title: FB-039 fail WebView tooling on recoverable parser errors
summary: Fix FR-054 by making WebView generated-artifact tooling treat Babel recoverable parser errors as fatal.
reason: Worker finding F-11-03 showed individual WebView generated-artifact checks could continue after Babel recovered from syntax errors such as duplicate lexical declarations.
behavior_before: Babel parser recoverable errors were retained on the AST but the tooling traversed and generated reports anyway.
behavior_after: Shared WebView script parsing throws when recoverable parser errors are present, and the godfile analyzer uses the same fail-closed parser.
manual_validation: Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.tooling.test_webview_tooling_checks -q passed, 2 tests.
Positive inline Node parseScript check passed.
npm run webview:map:check, webview:slices:check, and webview:contract:check reached stale generated-baseline failures tracked by FB-042.

tests.python.tooling.test_webview_tooling_checks passed; npm run webview:check passed; node --check passed for changed mjs files; inline parseScript positive check passed; generated-baseline checks remain stale under FB-042.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior parser helper and analyzer parse path, then rerun WebView tooling checks.
